method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A uniform flat grey grid, dimmer than the desk spill.
notes.fix: Tiles at value steps, the screen the brightest value, the camera in so the screen fills about half the width, the books cropped.

notes.problem: A stock monitor and slab books in a teal gradient void, a mid grey mesh screen, the largest mid tone block.
notes.fix: A built office over a reviewer's shoulder, an emissive screen as the brightest value and only source, the books deleted.

notes.problem: A generic monitor and books, a uniform grey mesh screen, no reviewer.
notes.fix: Apply value steps in the tile fill, the camera behind a reviewer's shoulder with a hand on a mouse, the monitor two thirds of the width.

notes.problem: The pale boom silhouette and flat tiled bark.
notes.fix: Remove the boom shape, replace the logs with the barked cut_limb models.

notes.problem: A cartoon ring lens, a pale faceted shape behind the pod, stretched bark, an empty top.
notes.fix: Recessed coated glass with one highlight, cyan only on the lamp, the boom culled, the camera dropped against the lit body side.

notes.problem: A flat cyan ring lens and a pale boom silhouette.
notes.fix: A recessed coated glass element with a dark bore and one hard specular, the boom darkened or occluded.

notes.problem: Brown haze, primitive cabs, under half the 50 trucks in view.
notes.fix: Drop the warm fog, raise the camera so all five rows recede in frame.

notes.problem: A brown-mauve haze in the top third, primitive box cabs.
notes.fix: Fog to the near black sky above the far rows, a chamfered hood and windscreen on the instanced cab.

notes.problem: A brown fog mid tone and toy box trucks.
notes.fix: Fog beyond the third row to the near black sky, the eye at about 12 m.

notes.problem: The label's last letters on the upright, a flat cyan tag, a dead left half.
notes.fix: The label on two lines ending clear of the upright, a paper stock tag with a cast, the camera in and down on the bare arm.

notes.problem: The label's last letters on the upright.
notes.fix: The label on two lines ending at least 40 px left of the upright, level with the tag.

notes.problem: A mannequin inspector beside a chunky cab that owns the frame.
notes.fix: Crop to the inspector and windrow with the truck's dark body as backdrop, rim light the figure.

notes.problem: A boxy cab primitive and a mannequin inspector.
notes.fix: Tighter on the inspector and windrow with the cab off the right edge.

notes.problem: The truck an eighth of the width, no dominant image.
notes.fix: The camera 12 to 15 m behind the truck so the body and pods fill a third of the width.

notes.problem: A bar chart drawn in sticks square on, labels over busy fence.
notes.fix: Rotate about 25 degrees off square and lower, tapered bent limbs, the fence a stop darker behind the labels.

notes.problem: A firewood load, a rust brown body, floating leaf cards.
notes.fix: Branchy brush with small leaves, cull the orphaned cards, swing to catch the white cab.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
